comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling finished homes to consumers with mortgage and title arms, not a lot developer selling to builders.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Largest homebuilder selling homes to consumers; lot development is secondary, and it is Forestar's parent and main customer.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling homes to buyers with mortgage and title services; buys lots rather than developing them for sale.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops residential lots and sells finished lots to third-party builders, though homebuilding is its larger business.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling to consumers; it buys land for its own homes rather than selling finished lots.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Lot-light homebuilder using option contracts, selling homes and mortgages to consumers; it is a lot buyer, not a developer.
